This is the [[quest]] where players owning both [[Nightfall]] and [[Factions]] campaign can travel to Cantha and gain the [[assassin]] [[hero]] [[Zenmai]].

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
* [[Guild Wars Factions]] linked to [[Guild Wars Nightfall]] on same account

=== Objectives ===
* Speak with [[Imperial Guardsman Linro]] in [[Kaineng Center]].
* Find Zenmai in [[Bukdek Byway]].
* Travel to [[the Undercity]]. Zenmai must survive.
* Stop the [[Am Fah]] from creating new afflicted soldiers.
* Defeat the demons.
* Speak with Zenmai{{sic|missing full stop}}
* Return to [[Clerk Arlon]] in [[Kamadan]] with Zenmai.

=== Reward ===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* Zenmai joins your party

=== Environmental changes ===
* During this quest, the number of foes in Bukdek Byway will be reduced to only 1-10, which makes [[Vanquisher|vanquishing]] easier. See [[Bukdek Byway#Notes|Bukdek Byway notes]].
* During this quest, some [[The Undercity#Bosses|bosses in the Undercity]] or several [[The Undercity (Winds of Change)#Bosses|bosses in that explorable area during Winds of Change]] will not [[spawn]] after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her.

== Walkthrough ==

See [[campaign travel]] for information on travelling to Cantha and Elona.

Leave from [[Kaineng Center]] and follow the quest map to Zenmai. After you talk to her, Zenmai will disappear into the [[Undercity]]. Proceed south to the entrance to the Undercity and follow the quest map to [[Lale the Vindictive]]. After you defeat him, a series of [[Am Fah]] will appear which you must also defeat. Following these battles, speak to Zenmai again. Then map travel back to Kamadan and speak to [[Clerk Arlon]] for your reward.

To complete the quest, Zenmai must stay alive the entire time. One option is to repeatedly order a Monk player or hero to use Healing Prayers or Protection Prayers skills on her. For players that are not level 20 yet, flagging your heroes and henchmen to tackle the mobs would be a good idea.  This also minimizes the chance of Zenmai dying, as she will stay behind with you.

== Notes ==
* Having this quest active can drastically reduce the number of foes required to [[vanquish]] [[Bukdek Byway]], less than 10 kills if combined with [[The Afflicted Guard]], [[The Drunken Master]] or [[Missing Daughter]], down to 60 otherwise.
* For the [[Guild Wars Nightfall]] campaign, [[Plague in Cantha]] given by [[Funwa Shento]] in [[Kamadan]] is associated with this quest.
* For the [[Guild Wars Prophecies]] campaign, [[Mhenlo's Request]] given by [[Firstwatch Sergio]] in [[Lion's Arch]] is associated with this quest.
* Combines very well with [[Mayhem in the Market]] if you are using a Factions character in this quest, as the number of Afflicted in the region are significantly reduced.
* The Torment creatures are affected from your [[Lightbringer (skill)|Lightbringer]] title effect as usual.
* Once you talk to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway, you need to escort her to the Undercity.  If you [[zone]] away from Bukdek Byway or enter the Undercity before she arrives, you need to re-enter and talk to Zenmai again. If Zenmai is missed after you have entered the Undercity, exit back to Bukdek Byway and re-enter.
* This quest replaced the now removed quest [[Gain Zenmai]]. If Gain Zenmai was completed, this quest can not be accepted. Likewise, if you have Gain Zenmai you can not start this quest until it is abandoned.

== Trivia ==
* The quest's name is a light reference to the 1997 Kevin Smith movie, [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chasing_Amy Chasing Amy].
